title: Report: Chicago Bears to sign James Lynch

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Report: Chicago Bears to sign James Lynch
sources.description: The Chicago Tribune’s Brad Biggs reported today that the Chicago Bears were signing 27-year-old defensive tackle James Lynch. The 6’4”, 295-pound Lynch was originally a fourth-round pick of the Minnesota Vikings in 2020 after playing his college ball at Baylor. He was in Minnesota until 2024, but missed all of 2023 with a knee injury […]
